messages:
maggie: Hey @support, customer AcmeInc reports their trial credits dropped from ~10k -> ~500 overnight. They run a nightly embed sync + rerank job. Can someone investigate? :frowning:
kevin: On it. Any request ids, logs, or timestamps from the customer?
maggie: They attached a screenshot showing lots of calls to /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank around 03:12 UTC and a bunch of retries.
sarah: Pulling our logs for that window now — seeing heavy fanout from the background worker 'vec-sync' on that host, and it's using a prod API key for requests. sample snippet:
```text
2026-02-12T03:12:01Z vec-sync job=1234 customer=acmeinc endpoint=/v1/embeddings status=202 attempts=1
2026-02-12T03:12:05Z vec-sync job=1234 retry attempt=2 error=timeout
2026-02-12T03:12:10Z vec-sync job=1234 attempt=3 endpoint=/v1/rerank status=200 tokens=450000
```
kevin: "prod key"? That job should run with an internal service key (not the customer's key). How did it pick up a prod key?
leo: Found the issue in last night's deploy: systemd unit template used REDWOOD_API_KEY instead of REDWOOD_INTERNAL_KEY for vec-sync. The host-level env on that machine contains the customer key. So vec-sync inherited the customer key.
maggie: So the worker effectively billed the customer's trial credits for background work. Yikes.
sarah: Repro steps I used: check /etc/systemd/system/vec-sync.service, it contains:
```ini
Environment="REDWOOD_API_KEY=%REDWOOD_API_KEY%"
```
should be REDWOOD_INTERNAL_KEY. Rolling back the unit now.
kevin: Mitigation plan: 1) stop vec-sync on affected hosts, 2) rotate/clear host env vars, 3) pause nightly cron, 4) issue refund and extend trial, 5) add deploy lint and runtime guards.
maggie: I've paused the nightly cron and stopped vec-sync on hosts i-0a12b3c and i-0d4e5f6.
billing-bot: refund queued: customer=acmeinc amount=9500 credits reason="erroneous consumption from misrouted env" ticket=#5432
sarah: Pushed a quick runtime assertion to the worker: if API_KEY looks like a customer key (prefix "cus_" in our env) fail fast and log an alert. Also adding an additional check that internal jobs must use REDWOOD_INTERNAL_KEY.
leo: Adding a deploy-time template linter that flags usage of REDWOOD_API_KEY in system services and a preflight that validates env var names before rollouts.
kevin: Customer reimbursement + 14 day trial extension processed. I also sent a short postmortem to AcmeInc and offered to share logs.
maggie: Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick fix — appreciate the extra trial time. Please confirm when it's safe to re-enable." I'll validate tomorrow and close after sign-off.
ops-bot: Incident logged INC-2026-082; severity=S2; owners=leo,sarah,kevin
maggie: Closing loop for now — rollback complete, reimbursements queued, deploy lint + runtime guard shipped. :white_check_mark:
